sections.content: You know every part of this argument from the unit: the future, comparisons, evaluation + subjunctive and *si* + imperfect subjunctive. Now state a position and support it with reasons.

items.spanish: En el futuro quiero trabajar menos y tener más tiempo libre.
items.english: In the future I want to work less and have more free time.

items.spanish: Creo que el equilibrio es más importante que el éxito profesional.
items.english: I think balance is more important than professional success.

items.spanish: Es importante que encontremos una forma sostenible de trabajar.
items.english: It is important that we find a sustainable way to work.

sections.content: Connect claims with *porque*, *sin embargo*, *por eso* and *aunque* to make the argument coherent.
